podcast.body: An indie single from 2007 found on a 5-song EP. It became "something of a sensation in certain indie circles in London" and sounded very different from the music that Ben Lovett would later make with Mumford & Sons. "This song is doo-doo-doo from 2007 and can be found on a 5-song EP."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
